run_mocap_demo: run the mocap demo by passing an AMC file path via the --filename flag
parse_amc_convert: parse and convert a CMU mocap AMC file into MuJoCo joint position arrays
create_humanoid_CMU_env: create a humanoid_CMU stand environment for motion capture playback
render_physics_frames: render physics simulation frames from two camera angles into a video array
playback_mocap_video: playback mocap video frames in real time using matplotlib with timed pauses
